items.text: On October 1, 1982, Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida, opened EPCOT Center to the public for the first time.
items.question: Did you ever make the trip to EPCOT Center, and who went with you?

items.text: Survivor's "Eye of the Tiger", from the film Rocky III, had a six-week run at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1982.
items.question: Where were you living when "Eye of the Tiger" was on the radio, and did you see Rocky III in a theater?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1982, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations, respectively. During the year, 16 different singles spent time at number one.
Additionally, the J. Geils Band and Survivor had six-week runs at number one with "Centerfold" and "Eye of the Tiger" respectively
"Eye of the Tiger", taken from the soundtrack of the film Rocky III, was the first number one for Survivor.

items.text: The St. Louis Cardinals beat the Milwaukee Brewers, 4 games to 3, to win the 1982 World Series on October 20.
items.question: Who did you watch or listen to the 1982 World Series with, and which team were you rooting for?
items.source_quote: October 20 – World Series: The St. Louis Cardinals defeat the Milwaukee Brewers, 4 games to 3, to win their 9th World Series Title.
